question: According to Census 2011 of India, which of the following group of states have the highest female literacy rates?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kerala and Mizoram. **__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to Census 2011 of India, literacy rate of** Kerala** is **94% (Male- 96.11% ; Female- 92.1%).**
 
• **9** out of **10** **females **are literate in this state.
 
• According to Census 2011 of India, literacy rate of **Mizoram** is** 91.58%** **(Male - 93.72% ; Female - 89.40%).**
 
• According to Census 2011, the literacy rate in the** country **is **74.04% (Male - 82.14% ; Female - 65.46****%) **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tamil Nadu :** 

 
 
• According to Census 2011 of India, literacy rate of **Tamil Nadu** is **80.09%** (Male - **86.77%** ; Female - 73.44%).
 
 
 
• **Bihar:**
 
 
• **Bihar** has the** lowest** literacy rate.
 
• ​Literacy rate of** Bihar **is** 61.8% (Male - 71.2% ; Female - 51.5%).**
 
 
 
• **Rajasthan:**
 
 
• According to the Census 2011 of India, the literacy rate of **Rajasthan** is** 67.06%** **(Male- 79.19% ; Female- 52.12).**
 
 
 
• **Sikkim:**
 
 
• According to the Census 2011 of India, the literacy rate of** Sikkim **is **81.40% (Male- 87.30% ; Female- 76.43).**
 
 
 
• **​ ​Nagaland:**​
 
 
• According to Census 2011 of India, the literacy rate of** Nagaland** is **79.55% (Male- 82.75% ; Female- 76.11).**
